title: HB 1014 (2010 Regular Session): Voter identification; require for all except certain older electors.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1)
(quote) Each person, except a person born before 1942, who shall appear to vote in person at a polling place or the registrar's office shall be required to identify himself or herself to an election manager or the registrar by presenting current state-issued photo identification.
(section) Sec. 1(2)(a)
(quote) Through December 31, 2010, the identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall be limited to
(section) Sec. 1(2)(b)
(quote) On and after January 1, 2011, the identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall be limited to the following: (i) A current and valid Mississippi driver's license; or (ii) A voter registration card with the elector's photograph and that lists the identification cardholder number required under the provisions of law regulating the Statewide Centralized Voter System.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Conforming 23-15-631(3)
(quote) The Secretary of State shall prepare instructions on how absentee voters may comply with the identification requirements of this act.
(section) Conforming 23-15-719
(quote) The registrar shall identify the applicant by requiring him to present identification as required by Section 1 of this act and then deliver the ballots to the applicant by mail or to the applicant in the registrar's office.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 2 (23-15-33)(3)
(quote) Every person entitled to be registered as an elector in compliance with this section shall be issued by January 1, 2011, a registration card with the elector's photograph and that lists the identification cardholder number required under the provisions of law regulating the Statewide Centralized Voter System.
(other) Sec. 3 (23-15-169.1): voter registration cards with photographs by Secretary of State and Commissioner of Public Safety, no cost
(other) Sec. 4: 23-15-163 brought forward
(other) Conforming amendments to 23-15-639, 23-15-11, 23-15-541, 23-15-719
(other) Preclearance and effective date
